solution.en: Please keep product serial number, model, purchase date, and invoice ready. Warranty status needs to be checked from official support records.
solution.bn: product serial number, model, purchase date এবং invoice প্রস্তুত রাখুন। warranty status official support record থেকে check করতে হবে।

escalation_message.en: Contact your nearest Excel Customer Support Point with the serial number and invoice.
escalation_message.bn: serial number এবং invoice নিয়ে nearest Excel Customer Support Point-এ যোগাযোগ করুন।

solution.en: If warranty is expired, paid service may be available after inspection by the support point.
solution.bn: warranty শেষ হলে support point inspection করার পর paid service পাওয়া যেতে পারে।

escalation_message.en: Visit the support link and contact the nearest CSP for service options.
escalation_message.bn: support link থেকে nearest CSP-তে service option জানুন।

solution.en: For warranty claim, take the product, invoice, serial number, and problem details to the nearest support point.
solution.bn: warranty claim করতে product, invoice, serial number এবং problem details নিয়ে nearest support point-এ যান।

escalation_message.en: The support point will inspect the product and guide the next step.
escalation_message.bn: support point product inspect করে পরবর্তী step জানাবে।
